snippet.title: Rust - Instrument Pack Incoming (DLC Teaser)
snippet.description:
The Rust Instruments DLC will be released on 5th December. Add it to your Steam Wishlist now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1174370/Rust__Instruments/

Learn more about the Instruments pack:
https://rust.facepunch.com/blog/instrument-pack-dlc
